blurb: Beaver Island Brewing Company brews and serves a wide range of beers including ales, IPAs, lagers, and hard beverages. They operate a taproom where guests can enjoy their beers and participate in community events like Tending for a Cause. The brewery focuses on quality, tradition, and community engagement.
extraNote: Tending for a Cause takes place regardless of rain, shine, snow, or cold · Donation checks mailed within 12 weeks via USPS; holidays may extend time · Taproom at Beaver Island Brewing Company
